messages:
ops_bot: PAGING: kv-cache eviction rate spike on cluster prod-gpu-eu; continuous-batching queue depth rising above SLO threshold. auto-escalation to #incidents.

sre_oncall_1: Seeing +50% p50 token latency on mixed workloads, tail 99th jumping. KV cache working set exploded to ~2.6x baseline. Paging alarms firing.

mira_ops: Confirmed — hosts in pool 7 hitting high disk IO from paging; tenant isolation shows mixed long/short requests from several customers.

jordan_prod: Is there a customer impact? Any 5xx or degraded responses?

eve_support: Multiple customers reported slow responses for generation and streaming drops. One enterprise (cust-redwood) flagged 2-minute token deltas.

katy_serving: I'm seeing continuous-batching backlog increase; scheduler is trying to pack long requests with short ones and then starving short latency-sensitive traffic.

alex_runtime: Posting current snippets from metrics:
```
kv_cache_size_bytes{pool="prod-gpu-eu"} 2.6e9
continuous_batch_queue_depth{pool="prod-gpu-eu"} 420
batch_scheduler_starved_short=1
latency_p99_tokens{route="/generate"} 2300ms
```

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2101. Pager duty notified. Assigning oncall.

sre_oncall_1: I'm taking it. Quick mitigation checklist: 1) reduce continuous batching target max_batch_size 2) enable kv-cache eviction throttle 3) route short requests to dedicated low-latency bucket.

mira_ops: Can we push a config hotfix to decrease max_sequence_batch_ms and force early flush? That might free queue slots.

alex_runtime: We can change runtime flag: `--continuous-batching-max-ms=30` -> current 120. Also `--kv-eviction-target=0.7` -> current 0.95.

jordan_prod: Potential regression window? Any deploys in last 3 hours to runtime or scheduler?

katy_serving: There was a scheduler tweak 2.5 hours ago that improved throughput for long-form, may have weakened fairness heuristics. Might be correlated.

ops_bot: Note from deploy-bot: `deploy/runtime/scheduler v3.14.7` at 2101231800 by katy_serving (flags: fairness=relaxed).

eve_support: Customer-facing note: advising impacted tenants about degraded latency and that we are working on mitigation. Keeping SLO owner in loop.

sre_oncall_1: Action plan, short term (next 15m):
- rollback scheduler fairness=relaxed -> default
- set continuous-batching-max-ms=30
- set kv-eviction-target=0.75
- add temporary routing rule: route requests with tokens<=128 to low-latency pool

mira_ops: I can apply the runtime flags to the hotpatch channel. Will coordinate with infra for safe rollout across pool-7.

alex_runtime: Pushing hotpatch: `kubectl set env ds/realtime-runtime CONT_BATCH_MAX_MS=30 KV_EVICT_TARGET=0.75 --namespace=prod-gpu-eu`

ops_bot: Deploy job started 2101234590. Health checks in place.

katy_serving: Rolling back scheduler fairness flag now to stable config. Command: `infractl deploy scheduler --flags fairness=default --pool prod-gpu-eu`

ops_bot: Scheduler rollback started 2101234605.

mira_ops: Hotpatch applied to 50% of nodes; monitoring queue depth and p99.

alex_runtime: Early telemetry: continuous_batch_queue_depth -> 420 -> 140 within 90s. kv_cache_size dropping toward baseline. p99_token_latency down ~45%.

sre_oncall_1: Nice. Are short requests unblocked?

katy_serving: Yes, tail latency for short requests (<=128 tokens) back to normal ~95th percentile within 3s.

jordan_prod: Any adverse side effects? Throughput drop for long requests?

mira_ops: Throughput for long-running batches dropped ~12% but still within customer SLA for best-effort tier.

ops_bot: Incident status: mitigation in place. Switching to monitoring for next 2 hours.

eve_support: Communicated to affected customers: updated message with estimated mitigation time and postmortem promise.

pm_lead: Need to schedule postmortem, include attribution (scheduler relax change + runtime batching defaults). Also run regression tests for mixed workload fairness.

sre_oncall_1: Post-incident tasks (assigned):
- [sre_oncall_1] write incident timeline and initial RCA
- [katy_serving] revert fairness experiment in feature flag system and add automatic rollback trigger
- [alex_runtime] add guardrail to continuous-batching config: don't allow max-ms > 80 when kv eviction target > 0.9
- [mira_ops] create runbook step for rapid routing of short requests to low-latency pool

ops_bot: NOTE: paging alert thresholds will be tuned to detect cache-working-set growth earlier.

jordan_prod: Suggest running synthetic mixed-short/long load test nightly against staging with the same scheduler flags to catch this earlier.

katy_serving: Agreed — I'll own adding that to the CI perf matrix.

eve_support: Customer follow-up template prepared; will send once postmortem is drafted.

sre_oncall_1: Closing the active mitigation window and moving this to postmortem track. If any regressions or rollback failures occur, re-open thread.

ops_bot: Incident INC-2101 moved to postmortem.

mira_ops: Quick note: we should consider quota isolation for long-running requests to avoid scheduler packing issues.

pm_lead: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow and assign owners for fixes.

sre_oncall_1: Adding final logs for traceability:
```
TRACE: scheduler.pack_attempts=987
TRACE: eviction_run_ts=2101234588
TRACE: hotpatch_rollout=50%->100% completed
```

ops_bot: Thread closed for now.
